name: Sagami Kou
source:
Department: Overseas Operations
First Impressions: Blunt, Cold

Because of some kind of circumstance he was separated from his mother at a young age and raised by his grandmother who is a famous fortune teller.
Because he doesn't know the reason behind it, he still holds a bit of animosity towards his mother.
He's the shy type and isn't sociable. But his exotic looks are a charm point that get him overwhelming support from all the female employees.
